thread:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT: P1 detected - unusual header 'X-RW-WATERMARK' present on large volume of auth-proxy requests. Pager oncall: @eva. See alert details: https://pagerduty.local/INC-7832 :rotating_light:
eva: pulling the alert up. initial look: sudden spike of requests with `X-RW-WATERMARK` that contains what looks like customer identifiers. rate ~5k reqs in last 10m. tagging SRE + Security.
mike: where is traffic originating from? any 5xx or auth failures reported?
alice: quick grep on indexer logs shows forwarded entries with header present. most responses 200, so not auth failures. traffic source IPs are mixed across regions, not a single attacker.
eva: sample log snippet:
```
GET /v1/infer 200 123ms
Host: api.redwood.ai
X-RW-WATERMARK: cust-42-xyz
User-Agent: curl/7.78.0
```
jon: interesting — that header looks like a watermark added by our log-forwarder to trace origins. could be debug metadata accidentally left in production pipeline. tagging @security for PII check.
security: triage plan: 1) confirm whether watermark values contain PII; 2) check if any logs with this header were forwarded to external buckets/partners; 3) if external exposure, rotate keys and notify impacted customers. ETA for initial findings: 30m.
mike: any CloudTrail evidence of external PutObject from indexer role?
alice: quick CloudTrail check: no external PutObject to public buckets in last hour, but I do see one recent replication/sync to `partner-observability-bucket` at 23:07 UTC by `indexer-shipper` role — need to confirm context.
eva: pinging #partners to see who pulled that dataset. @jon can you start key rotation for the indexer service account as precaution?
jon: starting rotation now. steps: revoke current access key for `indexer-shipper`, issue new key, update secret in k8s `indexer` namespace and trigger rolling deploy. command sequence: `aws iam list-access-keys --user indexer-shipper && aws iam create-access-key --user indexer-shipper` then patch k8s secret. will broadcast deploy ETA ~10m.
security: if partner already downloaded objects, request immediate deletion and proof of deletion. also assemble customer impact list — alice, can you export samples and count distinct watermark values and map to customer ids?
alice: exported a sample set (anonymized) — 178 unique watermark values. quick cross-check: ~12 match prod customer IDs (hashed mapping), rest look like internal/test ids. I'll DM the sensitive mapping to sec and eva for PII assessment.
eva: action items: disable watermark emission in indexer config, rotate keys (jon), confirm external partner deletion (security), assemble cust impact (alice). I'll own oncall coordination and customer comm draft.
mike: :thumbsup:
security: note for postmortem: config gating for debug headers, stricter sink ACL checks, and automated S3 upload alerts for anomalous metadata.
pagerduty-bot: Incident updated: status -> mitigating. Assigned: eva, jon, alice, security. Next update scheduled in 15m.
